svg.desc: Role-based hospital operations, end to end. How it works: patient → appointment → billing → pharmacy → PDF report. A Django system for patients, appointments, billing and pharmacy, with role-based access and PDF reports. My most-starred repository. Stack: Python, Django. Stars: 100, with 4 forks; Live: Render.
